'''Benefits'''
*One [[hero skill point]] is awarded for attaining rank 1 and two points for each of the other ranks, for a total of 15 points per character.
*As you increase your Lightbringer rank, talk to the [[Seeker of Whispers]] in the [[Chantry of Secrets]] to gain the following [[List_of_PvE-only_skills#Lightbringer_skills|PvE-only skills]]:
**{{skill icon|Lightbringer}} (title effect, rank 1 - Lightbringer)
**{{skill icon|Lightbringer's Gaze}} (rank 2 - Adept Lightbringer)
**{{skill icon|Lightbringer Signet}} (rank 3 - Brave Lightbringer)

== Acquisition ==

You earn Lightbringer points by:
* Completing [[:Category:Rewards Lightbringer points|quests that award Lightbringer points]].
* Killing specific [[creature type]]s while under the effects of a [[bounty]] (the amount depends on the [[region]] and whether it's [[normal mode|normal]] or [[hard mode]]).
* Turning in normal or hard mode copies of the [[Night Falls]] [[storybook]] to [[Source of Whispers]], with at least 9 pages filled.
* Turning in a [[Young Heroes of Tyria]] storybook to Source of Whispers, with at least 7 pages filled.
* Completing missions for the first time; from the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] onwards, you earn points for each level of completion, in both normal and hard modes.
**Obtaining the master's reward in all those missions in normal mode grants 855 Lightbringer points.
**Obtaining the master's reward in all those missions in hard mode grants 2,025 Lightbringer points.
* [[Vanquish]]ing [[explorable area]]s in [[Vabbi]] or [[the Desolation]].

=== List of Lightbringer farms ===
; [[Vabbi]] farms

* [[Resplendent Makuun]], eastern side
* [[The Hidden City of Ahdashim]], for a greater amount of Lightbringer points — [[#The Hidden City of Ahdashim|walkthrough]].

; [[The Desolation]] farms

=== Lightbringer farm walkthroughs === 
==== The Mirror of Lyss ====
[[Image:LB Farm Mirror.jpg|200px|thumb|right|Mirror of Lyss Lightbringer farm]]
* Start: [[Dzagonur_Bastion_(outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]]
* End: Near [[Honur Hill]]

This run can be completed in less than 10 minutes, and is recommended for players with lightbringer ranks 2 or less. There are exactly 9 groups of 4 elementals each, netting 72 LB points. Enter the Mirror of Lyss from the Dzagonur Bastion outpost, and obtain the [[Elemental Hunt]] bounty right outside. Follow this order: 1. Hit the elemental just south of the shrine, 2,3. head west and kill the 2 mobs,  4. head south onto a cliff and hit that mob, 5. head east and hit that mob, 6,7. head south, hit the next 2 mobs, and try to avoid the plant mob if possible, 8. continue south to the T-junction and hit that mob, 9. head south-east and hit the final mob.
*Note: The quest [[The Search for Survivors]] affects the elemental mob spawns, so abandon or complete that quest before the run.

==== The Hidden City of Ahdashim ====
{{section-stub}}
This is a good area to farm Lightbringer points, because of the multiple elementals. Bring a similar skill set as you did for the mission (AoE skills are recommended) and keep an eye on your heroes over-[[aggro]]ing the pop-ups. The elementals are in the decorated areas (such as the very first one and the one in back), with a few Roaring Ethers scattered around the caverns.

==== The Sulfurous Wastes ====
[[Image:SS Farm Sulfrous.jpg|200px|thumb|right|Route for the Sulfurous Wastes Lightbringer farm]]
[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E9P30TWZQpY&feature=channel_page Narrated Video Guide]

* Start: [[Remains of Sahlahja (outpost)|Remains of Sahlahja]] 
* End: [[Temple of the Monoliths]]
* Requirements:
** [[Requiem for a Brain]]
** [[A Show of Force]], [[Rune of DOOM]] in inventory.
** [[Hard mode]] 

This simple run can be completed with a 5-8 person team. One person in your party needs to have the quests [[A Show of Force]] and [[Requiem for a Brain]] active in their log. You must advance A Show of Force to the point where you have a ''Rune of DOOM'' in your inventory. Bring lockpicks; there are usually 2 or more chests along the route. There is no bounty for killing monoliths, so unless you are farming for [[Inscribed Shard]]s, you can ignore them. You can also save time by ignoring the Sunspear bounties.

Starting at the Remains of Sahlahja, collect the Sunspear bounty from the Ghostly Scout, and proceed SW following the map on this page. Run past any [[Desert Wurm (NPC)|Desert Wurms]]. After you have received the Lightbringer Bounty from the Ghostly Priest, make your way around the bend, and continue to follow the map. 

As you approach the temple area, pick up the [[Ancient Tome of Knowledge]], then drop it immediately; this triggers some more Margonites. Back track just around the north bend of your position to defeat them. Return to the temple and defeat the initial groups of monoliths. Activate only the first Shrine on your right (as you face the hall); this spawns another group of Monoliths as well as 3 bosses. After defeating them, [[resign]]; if you trigger all of the other shrines, you will have to abandon and restart the quests.

You can save 3-5 minutes by having the rune-carrying player rush the temple, activate the shrine, and rush out. 

A quicker alternative is to kill just enough Margonites and Monoliths to maximize the bounties for killing the boss. This yields 600 points instead of 666 for the complete farm. From the Ghostly Scout, head directly south (ignoring the Margonites to the north). You can ignore the nearby djinni or flag heroes and henchmen to kill them while you grab the bounty. Follow directions above for the Margonites until you have killed at least 25. Head for the temple but ''ignore the monoliths'' and immediately trigger the boss-shrine. Kill the bosses and resign.

==== The Shattered Ravines ====
If you do not have access to [[A Show of Force]] and [[Requiem for a Brain]], this slower farm is a good alternative, especially as you will be in wurm form most of the time. Start from the [[Lair of the Forgotten]] and take the quest [[Getting Even]] from [[Kane]] right outside the entrance. Make for the wurm spoor nearby, killing the few giants and pop-up insects along the way. Once in wurm form, head south to the entrance to [[Joko's Domain]] to obtain the Margonite bounty. Proceed in a roughly clockwise direction around the map, finishing with the boss [[Saushali the Frustrating]] in the northeast. This will obtain about 600-700 points in 30-35 minutes.

This run can be combined with Sunspear point farming by obtaining the giant hunt at the beginning, and the undead hunt from the shrine in the west-central portion of the map. There are two bosses to be killed: [[Uhiwi the Smoky]] and [[Koahm the Weary]]. Both of these can be encountered en route to Saushali.

==== The Ruptured Heart ====
This area is good for quick runs - around 180 points on average every 3-5 minutes (depends on how much firepower your party can dish out). This run can easily be done with heroes and henchmen. Head out the southwestern exit of [[the Mouth of Torment]] and get the [[Margonite Battle]] [[bounty]]. Start heading towards [[Rual, Stealer of Hope]] to the southeast. North of Rual's group will be a group of about 5 Margonites. Take them out without aggroing Rual. Remaining in that place, pull two more groups of Margonites (one normally 5-strong, the other 3-strong). Avoid aggroing the [[Graven Monolith]] group and the pair of land [[elemental]]s. Once accomplished, take out Rual's group, remembering to kill the boss the last to maximize the bounty bonus. Rinse and repeat for about 1,000 points in a half hour.

==== Nightfallen Jahai ====
[[Image:LB Farm Nightfallen Jahai 2.jpg|200px|thumb|right|Lightbringer farm in Nightfallen Jahai]]
* Start: [[Gate_of_Pain_(outpost)|Gate of Pain]]
* End: Boss [[Oath of Profanity]]
* Done with [[hero]]es and [[henchmen]]
* You should bring a [[MM|Minion Master]], a [[Mesmer]] for interrupts, the rest of the party should be for damage dealing and health booster.
* A hero with [[Spoil Victor]] and [[Arcane Echo]] is also a good choice
* Only hard mode

This run can be completed in less than 30 minutes, and is recommended for players with [[Lightbringer rank]] higher than 5. Enter [[Nightfallen Jahai]] from [[Gate_of_Pain_(outpost)|Gate of Pain]], kill the first [[Margonite]]s, get the Margonite Hunt blessing and continue until you reach the [[Resurrection Shrine]], point 3 on map, and get the Monster Hunt, just up there's point 4 where you will find the first boss, [[Shepherd of Dementia]], continue along the path and you will come across the 2nd boss [[Onslaught of Terror]], "[[vanquish]]" everything in your path and continue north where you will see a fortress the 3rd boss [[Chimor the Lightblooded]] (point 7), turn back South-East and continue down the path (remember to "[[vanquish]]" everything), at the end (point 8) you will fight the last boss [[Oath of Profanity]].
A complete run can reach as high as 1,200 Lightbringer points in 25 minutes (2,880 points per hour)

==== Domain of Anguish ====
{{section-stub}}
A complete run of the Domain of Anguish can net you 7,200 Lightbringer points from quests, plus 2 points per foe in normal mode and 8 per foe in hard mode. A complete run usually takes 2 hours total. (About 5500 lightbringer points per hour)

== Notes ==
* There are no bounties for Lightbringer points in [[Istan]].
* You will not be able to obtain Lightbringer bounties after gaining the first rank in the title until you return to the [[Chantry of Secrets]] and speak to the [[Seeker of Whispers]].
* Once you have achieved rank 5 for the Lightbringer title track, you may no longer turn in normal mode books to the Lightbringer Scrivener and you may not request normal mode books from him either. Consider waiting until your character is rank 5...
** and for an Elonian Support [[Weekly bonuses|weekly bonus]] before turning in secondary quests that award Lightbringer points.
** before vanquishing explorable areas in Vabbi or the Desolation. 
* Complete the Elonian [[Vanquisher]] title before farming Lightbringer points, since you might max your LB rank through vanquishing and associated quests.

==Trivia==
* Prior to the [[Game updates/20081113|13 November 2008 update]], completing missions from the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] onwards for the first time did not award Lightbringer points for each level of completion.
